free_text: Given the high-risk MRI finding (PI-RADS 5) and the rising PSA trend from 2.3 to 6.9 ng/mL, coupled with the palpable DRE nodus, a biopsy is indicated to establish the documented grade of the prior lesion. The rising PSA trajectory and high PI-RADS score strongly suggest a new or progressing high-risk lesion requiring histological confirmation. The evidence converged on the need for further investigation to guide definitive management.
